_about: The faction catalogue import (verify/from-bsdata.js chaos-daemons) reads BSData's whole Chaos Daemons catalogue (and the Daemons Library it imports root entries from) through verify/from-json.js as the export catalog-chaos-daemons; this is its hand file. weaponNames: a weapon BSData names otherwise than GW's datasheet (Wahapedia), so that GW's profile is found and its values checked; the app keeps BSData's name (New Recruit's, which the lists' signed-off rows and the in-app import use). fixes: GW's words where Wahapedia's transcription of a detachment differs ({ at:"<detachment>/<kind>/<name>", field, from, to, why }, exactly once), as for a list (verify/from-json.js). texts: the same for a datasheet's ability ({ "<datasheet id>": { "<ability>": { from, to, why } } }), where GW's Faction Pack prints the datasheet in full.

fixes.why: GW's Faction Pack Chaos Daemons (Plague Legion, Enhancements) names it "CANKERBLIGHT (AURA)"; Wahapedia "Cankerblight". GW's name, its (Aura) part of it, as the app writes an enhancement GW tags Aura (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt)
GW's Faction Pack Chaos Daemons (Lords of the Warp, Bilious Blessing, EFFECT) ends the bullet "For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound."; Wahapedia drops the full stop

Infected Outbreak.from: At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
Infected Outbreak.to: If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and this unit is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Infected Outbreak.why: GW's Faction Pack Chaos Daemons (legal from 30 Sep 2026) prints the Plaguebearers' datasheet: "If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and this unit is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn." (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt lines 2149-2153); Wahapedia's Level of Control wording is in no cached GW document. BSData agrees with GW

Leader.from: BEASTS OF NURGLE, PLAGUE TOADS, POX RIDERS
Leader.why: GW's Faction Pack Chaos Daemons prints Horticulous Slimux's LEADER section "This model can be attached to the following unit: ■ Beasts of Nurgle" (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt lines 2129-2130); Wahapedia also lists the Legends Plague Toads and Pox Riders. BSData agrees with GW

chaos-daemons/tormentbringer.why: GW's Faction Pack Chaos Daemons prints the Tormentbringer datasheet with "CORE: Deep Strike, Leader" (line 2717), "Hysterical Frenzy: Each time a model …" untagged (line 2724) and "KEYWORDS: Mounted, Character, Psyker, Chaos, Daemon, Slaanesh, Tormentbringer" (lines 2736-2737); Wahapedia's page, which the import reads, differs (its keyword names the Legends Exalted Seeker Chariot). BSData agrees with GW (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt)

chaos-daemons/contorted-epitome.why: GW's Faction Pack prints "Horrible Fascination(Psychic):" (line 2670): the name Horrible Fascination with its (Psychic) tag, a space missing; the tag stays in tag. BSData agrees (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt)

chaos-daemons/keeper-of-secrets.why: GW's Faction Pack prints "Shining Aegis: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+." (line 2469); BSData names it "Shining aegis" (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt)

abilityAdd.name: Shadow Form
abilityAdd.text: At the start of the battle round, select one Shadow Form ability (see below). Until the end of the battle round, this model has that ability.

chaos-daemons/belakor.why: GW's Faction Pack prints on Be'lakor's datasheet "Shadow Form: At the start of the battle round, select one Shadow Form ability (see reverse). Until the end of the battle round, this model has that ability." (lines 3032-3036); Wahapedia names it "Shadow Form Abilities:", so the import did not find it. GW's words, "(see below)" for the card's reverse, as Wahapedia writes it: the three Shadow Form abilities follow it; BSData's leaves "(see reverse)" out (verify/.cache/gw/eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_chaos_daemons-e67vyzvv3x-mownb49uc3.txt)
